notes: «عمن سمع» is a gap: one who heard Wahb, named by no name (rule 8)
«يقول عن ابن عباس» makes Ibn Abbas the last link; the saying is his (rule 6)
The leading «146-» is a report number and is left out

fixes.reason: RWY writes the kunya and the gap as one name; the text has the kunya, then an unnamed transmitter «عمن سمع».

evidence.quote: أبي عبد الرحمن عمن سمع وهب بن منبه
